const key = 'value';
interface QuotedGetter {
  get 'value'(): number;
  set value(input);
}
type QuotedSetter = { get value(): number; set 'value'(input) };
interface ComputedGetter {
  get ['value'](): number;
  set value(input);
}
interface ConstantGetter {
  get [key](): number;
  set value(input);
  get 0x10(): number;
  set 16(input);
}
class Counter {
  #count = 1;
  get 'value'(): number {
    return this.#count;
  }
  set value(input) {
    this.#count = input * 2;
  }
  get 1(): number {
    return 1;
  }
  set '1'(input) {
    console.log(input.toFixed(1));
  }
  get #label(): string {
    return 'label';
  }
  set #label(input) {
    console.log(input.length);
  }
  rename(): void {
    this.#label = 'renamed';
  }
}
const literal = {
  get 'value'() {
    return 2;
  },
  set value(input) {
    console.log(input.toFixed(1));
  },
};
const quotedGetter: QuotedGetter = { value: 3 };
const quotedSetter: QuotedSetter = { value: 4 };
const computedGetter: ComputedGetter = { value: 5 };
const constantGetter: ConstantGetter = { value: 6, 16: 7 };
const counter = new Counter();
counter.value = 3;
counter[1] = 2;
counter.rename();
literal.value = 4;
console.log(quotedGetter.value, quotedSetter.value, computedGetter.value, constantGetter.value, constantGetter[16]);
console.log(counter.value, counter[1], literal.value);
